user.title: Roborock camera
user.description: Pick a vacuum set up by the Roborock integration and enter the RTSP address of this robot's go2rtc stream (for example rtsp://go2rtc:8554/vacuum). Without it there is no camera entity; buttons and services still work.

error.not_roborock: This vacuum is not from the Roborock integration.
error.bad_stream: Use an rtsp:// address without user, password or query.

abort.already_configured: This vacuum is already set up.

error.bad_stream: Use an rtsp:// address without user, password or query.

move.name: Drive
move.description: Drive the robot like a joystick. Send again within the duration to keep moving; it stops by itself 1.5 s after the last move.

velocity.name: Speed
velocity.description: Forward (positive) or back, up to 0.3 m/s.

patrol.name: Patrol
patrol.description: Drive through map points with the camera on.

map_index.name: Map
map_index.description: Map number, 0 for the first floor map.
